screenedNotAdmitted.reason: Historical USLE table contains annual crop/land-use C rows, including generic cereals, fruit trees and forage. These are not assigned as crop-specific RUSLE management observations. The preceding release made the same distinction. Original table remains saved and hash-verified.
General rotation principles support background reasoning, but do not establish a crop-specific magnitude. No crop benefit is automatically generated by matching a family or general principle.

The visually reviewed page gives a pooled fixation figure. It does not establish a separately measured range or residual N credit for each of lentil, chickpea and faba bean. Only qualitative physiological guidance is admitted.
System-level fertilizer reduction and soil-carbon statements are not converted into crop-specific kg N/ha, infiltration rates or sequestration rates. No yield, price or income record is extracted.
Only explicit named rows/groups and their stated management scenarios are mapped. A maximum effective rooting-depth range does not demonstrate soil-structure change or measured infiltration.

fallback: All remaining crop/effect combinations receive explicit model_recall with confidence, basis, date and no quote, except genuine not-applicable traits. Recalled knowledge is not labelled as evidence from any screened source.
